_README: THE LIVE-ORDER KILL SWITCH for bcs/spread_monitor.py.
Set trading.enabled to false to stop the monitor placing real exit orders.
It keeps watching and alerting -- you then close by hand.
This file is TRACKED in git (force-added; .gitignore excludes Helper/config/)
so the switch has history and ships with the code. The repo is PUBLIC:
NEVER put a token, folder id, credential path or account number in here.
Secret-bearing settings live in the untracked config/*_config.json overlay.
config/bcs_config.json may ALSO carry trading.enabled. Either file saying
false disarms; there is no precedence, both are stop buttons.
